LanguageData.RHA_StarConduit030_Broken: Guard reserve exhausted. Core remains exposed — finish it!
LanguageData.RHA_StarConduit030_Guards: Break the guard: {0} remaining Damage-qualified guards: {1}/{2}
LanguageData.RHA_StarConduit030_Contribution: Applicant damage: {0}/{1}. Credit is earned when this guard falls.
LanguageData.RHA_StarConduit030_Rules: Defeat every guard and meet the personal contribution requirement: 12 points at stages I–III, 24 at IV–V. The applicant or their summons earn 12 when a guard falls after they deal damage equal to 20% of its core health. Allies may finish it. Shields supplied by the applicant earn 1 point per damage actually absorbed from a trial enemy. Healing by the applicant earns 1 per point of unrepaired injury inflicted by a trial enemy within the last 30 seconds. Damage and support can be combined, but each enemy provides at most 12 points in total. Old wounds, friendly fire, self-inflicted wounds and injuries already healed by someone else do not count. Missed openings preserve boss wounds and contribution, bringing small guard waves at most twice. After the last wave, the core stays exposed. Breaking the seal staggers the core for three seconds and cancels pending ground bombardments and charged barrages. Already launched projectiles remain dangerous. No new ground bombardments begin during an opening. At stages I–III, bombardments and charged barrages take turns. Missing contribution brings one replacement at a time, up to 12; then the trial ends. Leave red warnings before impact.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_Contribution: Applicant contribution was insufficient. Helpers cannot complete the entire personal assessment.
LanguageData.RHA_StarConduit030_Brief: While shielded, the core attacks only with marked ground bombardments; its ordinary cannon returns after exposure. Defeat the guards, then focus fire on the exposed core. Earn {0} contribution unit(s): qualify through damage to a defeated guard, or absorb and repair 12 points of trial enemy damage with your own shields and healing. These routes can be combined, but each enemy provides at most one unit. Healing only counts unrepaired trial injuries inflicted within 30 seconds. Each opening starts with three seconds of core stagger and cancels pending mechanism attacks. Openings last {1}s; the trial lasts {2}s. Missed openings preserve wounds and contribution. At most two reserve waves can restore the seal; after the last clear, the core stays exposed.
LanguageData.RHA_StarConduit030_SealedFire: While shielded: dodge marked bombardments. The cannon opens fire after exposure.
